Title: Generally Available: Virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel

Body.Content:
Azure virtual network flow logs connector with Microsoft Sentinel is now generally available, enabling you to seamlessly export and analyze network traffic data within your security operations workflows. 

With this integration, you can bring rich, network-level visibility from virtual network flow logs directly into Microsoft Sentinel, empowering security teams to detect threats, investigate incidents, and correlate network activity with broader security signals across your environment. 

By combining detailed traffic insights with advanced analytics and threat detection capabilities from Microsoft Sentinel, you can strengthen your security posture, accelerate incident response, and gain a unified view of network and security data. 

Through a native Microsoft Sentinel connector for virtual network flow logs, you can now operationalize this data with out-of-the-box alerts on your log analytics workspaces, leveraging enriched flow log data for your SecOps workflows 

Learn more.
